stories.title: Montreal sputters late, loses Grey Cup again
stories.summary: The Montreal Alouettes' potent offence sputtered in the fourth quarter and the team went home from the Grey Cup empty-handed a second straight year.

stories.title: Philpot named Grey Cup’s top Canadian in defeat
stories.summary: There was no consolation for Tyson Philpot after he was named the Grey Cup's most valuable Canadian in a losing cause Sunday night.

stories.title: Edmonton Elks win the Grey Cup, defeat Montreal Alouettes by 37-30
stories.summary: The win follows a decade-long journey to revive the Edmonton team, which went six seasons of not making the playoffs and had a drop in attendance amid a 22-game home losing streak.

stories.title: Carney, Plamondon agree to Quebec summit and tackling homelessness
stories.summary: Plamodon said he discussed the federal government's plan to end homelessness and said the prime minister agreed to Quebec choosing the projects involved.

stories.title: Call of the Wilde: Colorado Avalanche hand the flat Montreal Canadiens a home defeat
stories.summary: The Canadiens faced a weaker Avs club, but they still have a lot of firepower. Montreal turned in a flat effort. It happens in a long season: Colorado 4 Montreal 1.

stories.title: Alouettes, Elks clash in a battle of divisional powers at 113th Grey Cup game
stories.summary: The 113th Grey Cup game Sunday at McMahon Stadium in Calgary will be a battle of divisional leaders and winners.

stories.title: Lehkonen, Blackwood lead Avalanche past Canadiens
stories.summary: Artturi Lehkonen had a goal and an assist to help the short-handed Colorado Avalanche beat the Montreal Canadiens 4-1 without injured stars Nathan MacKinnon and Cale Makar on Saturday night.

stories.title: More electric vehicles exempt from luxury tax, Ottawa says
stories.summary: Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne announced that starting Friday, all electric vehicles that cost less than $150,000 would be exempt from the 10 per cent tax.

stories.title: Beer recall hits 2 more Canadian products, bringing total to 31
stories.summary: Quebec-based Archibald Inc. issued the recall for its Nuit Blanche White IPA 473 ml cans as well as four packs due to pieces of metal.

stories.title: Call of the Wilde: Montreal Canadiens win convincingly over the Bruins in Boston
stories.summary: It was the first time that the Montreal Canadiens battled for first place in a head-to-head this season. It doesn't get bigger the Bruins in Boston. The Habs score a solid 5-2 win.
